notes.title: Early Access Release Changelog
notes.notes:
Lost In The OpenChangelog


We have implemented a great deal of changes since the last date we provided a changelog of in June. We are finally ready to enter Early Access. 

Below are all the changes we have implemented since then that we can remember and are not just run-of-the-mill bug fixes and so on. 



New ContentAbilities & Combat Systems
* New abilities added:

  * Virulent Strike – new harmful attack.

  * Rending Strikes – added to Volkver and Grunt.

  * Quickstep Strike – added to Bounty Hunters.

  * Gushing Wound – added to Grunts.

  * Wounding Strike – added to Spearmen.

  * Smother Arrowhead – added to Bandit Archers.

  * Vulture Strike – new Bandit Pikeman ability.

  * Staunch Wound – added to Stratha Units and Polyomian Sentinel.

  * Mocking Taunt – new ability.

  * Bulwark – new shield ability, effectively a counterpart to Raise Shield.

* **Effect categories** (Neutral, Beneficial, Harmful) implemented.

* **Inherent Passives added:**

  * Chop Through (Scouts).

  * Swift Shooter (Archers).

  * Partial Armor Damage (Maulman).

  * Decapitation (Brute).

  * Passives also added to Polyomian Macebearers, Enforcers, Bounty Hunters, and others.


Leadership & Insights
* New Leadership Tactics:

  * Multiple new options added, including improvements to flanking maneuvers and stamina refunds.

  * Added Focused Volley, a leadership tactic focused on ranged units.

  * Added Rallying Strikes, a leadership tactic focused on tight combat formations.  

* New Insights:

  * Warmonger, Survival Training, Salvager, Precision Training, Side Dealings, Strike With Purpose, Shared Knowledge, and more.


Traits
* New traits: Energetic, Strong-Willed, Weak-Willed.


Units & Presets
* Bandit Pikemen introduced:

  * New pike-based abilities.

  * New inherent passive added.

* Additional units and updates:

  * Overhaul of Bandit Spearmen. He is no longer a 2-tile unit.

  * Updated all enemy presets in the game, giving them new abilities, etc.


Art, Icons & UI Assets
* Large batch of new icons:

  * Attachments, items, perks, enhancements, recruitment, stat enhancements (square/hex variants), ability icons (Pinpoint, Lethal Strike, etc.), precondition icons.

* New portraits added for Macebearer, Maulman, etc.

* New zone banners when entering a new zone.

* New UI elements:

  * Mortal Wound warning UI.

  * Additional dimmers for unselected abilities/tactics in character panel.

  * Improved icons for stat enhancements.


Scenarios
* Big installation of new scenarios, including ‘transition’ specific encounters.

* Unique scenario rewards implemented across all transition scenarios.

* New final scenario implemented.



Gameplay & BalanceGeneral Balance
Balance, generally, should be greatly improved. We have tweaked so many things that it cannot be contained in this changelog. Below is a summary of what has changed.



* Unit difficulty values adjusted:

  * Ursadons made less punishing.

  * Worfangs made more plentiful in combat.

  * Difficulty values across all zones have been tweaked back and forth.

  * Leader unit battles in general slightly nerfed.

* Unit stat scaling & recruitment:

  * Recruitment cost scaling increased across units.

  * Recruitment cost in general significantly increased.

  * Recruitment levels randomized more in zones 2–3 (including chance of lower-level units).

  * Materials cost for upgrading equipment significantly increased.

* Experience & progression:

  * Adjusted XP gains:

    * More XP awarded per kill. However, experience that is distributed to other units is massively reduced.

    * Scenario XP reduced.

    * Fixed issues where units leveled incorrectly in vendors or gained wrong skill points.

* Economy:

  * Increased scaling of unit costs based on level.

  * Provisions cost for the King reduced from 3 to 1.

  * Many leadership insights and various traits and so on now scale dynamically instead of yielding flat amounts.

  * Attachment costs lowered overall.


Abilities & Traits
* Dozens of ability fixes, buffs, and nerfs, including:

  * Buffs: Rapid Recovery, Blood Amulet, Heroic Strike (left path), Provoke, and more

  * Nerfs: Flanking Strike, Bogged Down, Coalition Power, Disciplined, Flanking Maneuvers Stamina Refund, many Ursadon abilities, and more

  * Reworks: Oiled Bolts now extend burning duration, Smother Arrowhead applies Stamina Reduction, Raise Shield adjusted to give Block Rating (not Protection Rating), and more

  * Fixed tooltips and mechanics: Victory Rush, Ironhide, Dazing Strike, Staunch Wounds, Crescendo Strike, Firebolt, Overhead Smash, Warmonger Insight, Defensive Order, Momentum Builder, Windup Strike, Energetic tooltip, and more.


AI Improvements
* Ranged units will now back away from adjacent enemy units before shooting and reloading.

* Two-tile units will back away from adjacent enemy units before attacking.

* AI caching optimizations for performance.

* Squashed a bug where certain enemy units had significantly higher starting attributes.

 
Audio & VisualsSound & Music
* Combat audio:

  * New SFX for death, injuries, blocking, buffs/debuffs, armor hits (per armor type), armor shatter, weapon swings (billhook, flail, 2h mace, hammer, etc.).

  * Defeat and Victory music sounds with proper transitions.

  * Added Death and Injury indicator SFXs.

  * Updated effect sounds (Bleeding, Poison, Stun).

  * Separate SFX for positive and negative buffs.

* Worldmap & ambience:

  * Animal sounds for Ursadon and others.

  * New tough encounter music.

  * New music for animals.

  * New music for repentance path event.

  * New UI sounds (hover, confirm, unavailable, back).

  * Transition area sounds (Outskirts, Deepwoods, Outlands).

* Main menu:

  * New main menu music and background ambience.

  * New sounds for UI interactions (New Game confirm, unavailable action, vendor interactions, skill upgrades).


Visual Effects
* New death VFX.

* New injury VFX.

* Blood splatter effect in combat. Togglable.

* Shield blocking VFX, one for each shield type (e.g. Buckler, Shield).

* Improved stamina bar responsiveness.

* Improved visuals for when characters move during attacks/blows.


Animations
* New idle animations for Macebearers, Ursadons, Worfangs, and more.

* New animations for Bandit Pikemen.


Worldmap & ScenariosZones & Transition Areas
* Full implementation of zones and transition areas (The Outskirts, Deepwoods, Outlands).

* Transition areas now include:

  * A buffer against Stratha encroachment, giving the player a “break” between different zones from being pursued.

  * Unique transition scenarios with unique rewards and enemy units.

  * Unique pre-/post-transition scenarios, with unique events.


Biomes & Visuals
* Added new hextile types: impassable and slow-passable variants.

* Improved encounter maps visually for the biome Withering Grove.

* Clouds and birds added with animations.

* Lakes and rivers updated with better ambience.

* Updated fogging.

* Significant improvement of visuals of all hex tiles in the game


Pathing & Map Generation
* Improved Dead-end detection and repair implemented.

* Improved pruning of overlapping paths.

* Fixed issues with saving/loading transition nodes.

 
UI & UX
* Main Menu:

  * New animated main menu.

  * Logo localized to Simplified Chinese.

  * Discord link and Simplified Chinese localized social media button added.

  * Improved Difficulty Selection visuals.

  * Improved Settings menu visuals.

* Combat UI:

  * Turn tracker highlights unit portraits when hovered, and allows inspection via RMB.

  * ESC key closes current open panels before pause.

  * Improved hotbar/stamina previews (show stamina loss on hover, availability after movement, reset on hover over UI).

  * Improved UX for the turning arrow helping you decide the direction of your character when moving in combat

  * Updated visuals for all tooltips in the game.

  * Tooltip UX improved with clearer positive/negative/warning color titles.

  * “Blocked!” text added when fully blocking an attack.

  * Killed and Injured units during combat will persist in the army panel, showing what has happened to them.

  * Stamina gains during combat show as combat text.

  * Improved combat camera movement.

  * Overall improved UX experience in combat.

* Character Panel:

  * Improved character panel visuals with better visual emphasis on what is important.

  * Added injury overlay in character panel to make treating injuries significantly clearer.

  * New sound for opening/closing character panel.

* Vendors/Recruitment:

  * Resource panel colors corrected (gold coins red when insufficient).

  * Icons and tooltips improved.

  * New sound for opening/closing vendors.

* Other Improvements:

  * Loading screen added for scene transitions.


Localization
* Major localization overhaul:

  * Hundreds of fixes across abilities, leadership, insights, scenarios, tooltips, and UI.

  * Rewrites of: ability chains, genproperties, perks, abilities, tutorials, notifications, scenario texts.

  * Consistency improvements (British English spellings, Z→S fixes).

  * Full update of Chinese localization + added logo + social media button.

  * Better save/load handling of locale in menus.


Performance & Stability
* Performance Optimizations:

  * Significant caching improvements in UI and AI scripts across both overworld and combat scenes.

* Stability Fixes:

  * Fixed numerous save/load issues (scenarios, nodes, trader availability, transition states).

  * Fixed various bugs, e.g. targeting bugs, stamina effects not applying, tooltip inconsistencies.

  * And tons more stability fixes.


Demo & Build Support
* Demo build system implemented:

  * Restricts playthrough to a limited part of the game.

  * Demo win screen and proper end screens for win/loss/demo.


Summary
Since late June, Lost In The Open has seen a huge expansion of content (abilities, traits, units, scenarios, art, icons, music), heavy gameplay balancing, major localization cleanup, UI/UX polish, audio-visual upgrades, and significant performance/stability improvements.



The game is now richer, smoother, more balanced, and more stable. It is ready for Early Access.



We hope you enjoy the game on Friday! We will happily read your reviews and feedback. 



Feel free to join our Discord.



Kindly,

Black Voyage Games

notes.title: Release in 4 days
notes.notes:
Hello all



We've been crazy busy preparing for release recently and haven't made any updates in news.



We have addressed what players found to be the most important issues in the game. For example, the injury system which was unintuitive has had a major UI improvement. Localization has been greatly improved. Difficulty tweaked to be more even across the playthrough, and clearer. Etc.



We will make a huge post about all the changes made to the game. Should come soon, right before or on release.



We are very excited about launch, hoping everything goes well. Thank you to those who have been playing the game and giving feedback, it has been invaluable.



Thank you for reading,

Black Voyage Games

notes.title: Lost in the Open - Big Demo Update
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We're coming to you today with a message and an update.

Whether this is your first time in the "Open" or arriving from the MGN Carnival, a warm welcome! We're glad to have you with us as you try our turn-based, strategy-driven dark roguelike, Lost in the Open.

To give Lost in the Open the showcase it deserves, we’ve decided to update the available demo. This new build includes a number of refinements and changes we've been working on for several months now, all of them designed to better reflect the direction and tone we're looking to achieve moving forward.

Here’s what’s new in the demo:
– A reworked Leadership System with Insights and Tactics that shape your party's growth and combat potential
– King Progression: Your ruler now evolves—and if he falls, it’s game over
– A revamped Injury System with lasting effects and high-stakes consequences
– Complete Equipment and Vendor Overhaul
– Save/Load support and a cleaner UI
– Now available in Simplified Chinese

Whether you find it enjoyable or unnervingly suspenseful, we invite you to follow King Nrvesk as he flees through the deadly lands of Ruedome, fighting not only for the continuation of his legacy but for survival.

* Black Voyage Games

notes.title: ***Patch 0.5.5***
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We hope you had a refreshing summer! Apologies for the long break from posting; development in summer slowed down a bit as everyone on the team enjoyed some well-deserved breaks and vacations. But don’t worry—we’ve jumped back into action and have some exciting updates to share with you.

MAJOR UPDATES

 New Worfang enemy: This enemy now spawns in dense and normal forest. Worfangs attack in packs, ambush players, and can tear units apart! Beware of their pinning ability, which can disable one of your units and requires assistance to break free.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/11d202a2dc17b0fe44d3a74bbe3f0e955c0213af.gif
 Environmental tiles: We’ve added environmental tiles that cause negative effects if you stand on them. The game now features Rusty Traps, Muddy Ground, and Overgrown Roots, appearing in various biomes.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/65c8b52b4c58f9261560668078768aaee1d7337f.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/5197bf2189577dfeb466c289d38eefe98da35858.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/e2314b055ac0e5964f04f82da0f0176a80b41cf9.jpg
 New Barricade sprites for blockade encounters: Barricades now visually differentiate battles where enemies have set up defenses opposed to regular camps, adding more variety to encounters.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/93ffc298f54b8ce11f18fc5d6f5206066c7462a2.jpg
 Probabilistic tiles: Some tiles now randomize what spawns on them. For example, a tile might spawn a tree, or it might spawn nothing. Alternatively, a tile could spawn Muddy Ground, a crate, or other elements. This introduces randomness to combat maps that wasn’t present before.
 Improved Tree Art: We’ve enhanced the art for all trees in the game, providing a more immersive visual experience. (Check environmental tiles images for refference)

MINOR UPDATES

Adjustments:

 Improved "Rage" tooltip
 Updated tooltip descriptions for all stats
 The "Skeleton Key" no longer drops from encounters
 Renamed "Strange Figurine" to "Blind Frenzy" with the same functionality as before
 Renamed "Daunting Strike" node upgrade to "Misdirected Frenzy," prioritizing hitting allies
 Renamed "Blind Rage" perk to "Focused Frenzy," prioritizing hitting enemies
 Abilities that cause displacement (e.g., pushback or disengage) will now function even if the target tile is unwalkable
 "Whirlwind" can no longer be used by the AI if they only have allies nearby
 Consolidated "Open Wound" tooltip for both 1-tile and 2-tile versions
 Improved "Final Flourish" tooltip to better reflect its effects

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed the "Peak Condition" buff, which was being removed too early in the previous version
 Fixed a bug where ending a turn too early (while still walking) caused errors in the game
 Fixed "Prey on the Weak," which wasn’t functioning correctly in the previous version
 Fixed "Reload" to no longer display a cooldown

Balance Adjustments:

 Buffed "Precise Strike" for two-handed melee units
 Buffed "Designate Target"
 Buffed "Mark Target" to always hit the target
 Buffed several equippable items
 Buffed "Finishing Blow" and added new upgrade nodes
 Buffed Brute’s final equipment by 1 armor rating
 Lowered upgrade costs on the left side of the "Wild Strikes" chain
 Nerfed the overall difficulty of Stratha units, resulting in fewer units spawning compared to before
 Nerfed "Open Wound"
 Added an extra upgrade node for "Adrenaline"
 "Thousand Strikes" was nerfed and reintroduced
 Enforced a minimum of 1 damage on Damage Over Time effects (they can no longer deal 0 damage)
 All Standard Enhancements—"Aggressiveness," "Survivability," and "Versatility"—now have 3 possible tiers that can randomly appear during level up. Higher ranks of these enhancements progressively become stronger.


SNEAK PEEK
If you’ve made it through all the changes, congratulations! We have something too cool not to share with you. We proudly present the mighty Ursadon! More info to come.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/7254cdb94be29aa4c8ca95c289f9f5f1d30e7a36.gif

notes.title: **Patch 0.5.0**
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We have some exciting news about the newest patch, 0.5.0. This update introduces a lot of new content to the game. Let's go through the list together.

Major Changes:

Devastating Wound - A new narrative feature gives the King a devastating wound after an unsuccessful assassination attempt at the start of the game. This makes the King significantly weaker, lowering his health and stamina. However, we have compensated for this by buffing the bodyguards. The debuff can be removed with some help after traveling for some time. This feature is currently a work in progress, but in the future, we plan to enable a "hard mode" through this event, allowing players to refuse this help.

New Unit: Stratha Arbalest - Now you can acquire Stratha Arbalest deserters. This unit has a shorter range than the regular archer, but can deal a lot of damage in quick succession. It also has the Fire Shot ability, which is unique to the Arbalest unit.

New Unit: Stratha Swordsman - Another recruitable Stratha deserter unit. This one can become a serious damage dealer. With access to many melee abilities and great basic attack upgrades, this unit can become very impactful on the battlefield when upgraded.

New Unit: Enforcer - A true tank unit armed with a mace and shield. This unit has the highest basic armor and armor efficiency in the game. Despite its low damage output, this unit shines with defensive options and crowd control abilities.

New Unit: Bounty Hunter - A squishy, high damage dealer with the highest base movement speed in the game. This unit dual-wields a rapier and a dagger, either of which can be upgraded for a unique playstyle. Will you opt for a duelist setup or a flanking assassin?

New Recruit Events - With new units, we had to adjust the current recruit events. Many previous events were adjusted to include chances of acquiring some of the new units, and we've added unique events that guarantee some of the new ones.

Adjusted Accuracy - We have adjusted accuracy in the game as it was slightly higher than we wanted it to be, making future accuracy stacking much valuable. To compensate, we also distributed accuracy stats across all weapon upgrades.

Equipment Upgrade Cost - With the accuracy adjustment and its impact on the game, we have decreased the equipment upgrade cost to incentivize upgrading equipment.

Bodyguards' Starting Abilities - Bodyguard Volkver now starts with the "Open Wounds" ability and Marske starts with "Shield Bash." This change provides players with better starting playstyle options, whether they prefer the original tank-bodyguard playstyle or a more balanced damage dealer approach.

Passive Healing Change - Passive healing while traveling has been adjusted from a flat value to 12%/8%/5% based on the selected difficulty.

New Upgrade Options - We've added many upgrade options to slightly underwhelming abilities through the skill point system to make them more viable.

Two Traits for Units - Units now have a chance to receive two traits instead of one.

Minor Changes:

Buffed Abilities:
•	Ebb and Flow
•	Wild Strikes
•	Aimed Shot
•	Hamstring Shot
•	Knockback Strike
•	Piercing Strike
•	Unbalancing Strike (this one is particularly challenging to balance o_O)
•	Isolated
•	Bully
•	Solidarity

Nerfed Abilities:

•	Open Wounds

Apart from these balancing changes, we have also identified and corrected a huge list of bugs, too extensive to be listed here. With so much new content, some bugs may have slipped through the cracks, so we encourage you to report any issues on our public Discord or leave a comment on our community page.
That’s all for today’s patch notes. We hope you enjoy the recent changes as much as we did.

All the best from,
The Black Voyage Games Team

notes.title: **Patch 0.4.5**
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We're excited to bring you Patch 0.4.5, featuring many exciting changes to Lost In The Open.

**Armor Rework** - Instead of simply reducing physical damage, armor now grants extra "buffer" health. This buffer takes reduced damage, and once it breaks, the character becomes vulnerable and takes full damage from all physical attacks.

**Scaling Recruits** - Previously, recruits started at level 1, often resulting in them being killed in their next fight without a chance to level up. Now, recruits will reach level 2 at 40% completion of the map and level 3 at 80% completion.

**Random Recruit Abilities** - New recruits now gain a random second ability instead of a fixed one. This change allows players to experiment with different abilities and explore their upgrade paths.

In addition to these significant quality-of-life improvements, we've made numerous UI enhancements and tooltip corrections for clearer understanding of game mechanics. We've also focused on balancing updates, particularly on XP gain and buffing some underwhelming abilities.

**Bug Fixes:**
- Fixed the "Achilles Heel" effect
- Corrected buffs/debuffs staying one turn longer than intended
- Fixed the "Second Wind" perk
- Corrected the duration of "Rally"
- Fixed "Critical Surge" not proccing
- Fixed "Mobility" not proccing
- Resolved issue where upgraded "Daze" allowed "Paralyze" effect to be procced with any other "Daze" effect
- Fixed "Adrenaline" to give the correct amount of stamina
- Fixed being able to afford "Cutting Gems" without having enough money
- Fixed the duel event freezing the game, preventing further progress
- Fixed "Daze" on the basic attack upgrade of Bodyguard to have the correct duration
- Fixed duplicated descriptions on abilities
- Fixed game freeze during the merchant event
- Fixed game freezing at the start, forcing players to restart

notes.title: Kickstarter Update and The Plan Forward!
notes.notes:
🚀 Hey there! Kickstarter Update and The Plan Forward! 🚀

First off, we want to give a massive shoutout to all of you amazing folks who were with us from the start of our Kickstarter campaign. Unfortunately, as many of you know, the Kickstarter was canceled due to a lack of momentum.

Now, don't worry, we're not throwing in the towel! The Kickstarter provided invaluable insight into issues with the game and has made us truly appreciate the importance of getting feedback directly from players. As a consequence, we're more grounded than ever to make this game a reality, and we've got a solid plan moving forward.

🎮 Searching for a Publisher

We're on the hunt for a publisher who's as stoked about our game as we are. Testing the waters, the response we've gotten so far has been promising. Teaming up with a publisher will give us the resources and expertise we need to take this game to the next level. We're committed to delivering something that'll blow your socks off, and a publisher will help us do just that.

🌄 Heavily Revamped Exploration

We've been grinding away to make the exploration part of the game far, far more compelling. It is now much more strategic and clear. The world you're gonna dive into is now more dangerous, more dynamic while also much more understandable to casuals and hardcore alike.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/00d9ac9e8235b6d6e419a4a1a4d840a3200b37b3.gif

🖼️ Fresh Steam Page Updates

Our Steam page just got a major facelift. We've loaded it up with tons of new screenshots and gifs that showcase the revamped exploration and improved combat. We hope you can see much clearer what we are going for with this game. It's all about making this game as compelling as it can be, and conveying that!

💬 Hang Out on Discord and Follow Us on Twitter

We want to keep the conversation going with all of you. It is incredibly important for the future of LITO. If you are interested, please consider joining our Discord channel for real-time chats, updates, and to be a part of the development journey. And give us a follow on Twitter @blackvoyagegame if that's your platform. Your feedback and enthusiasm mean the world to us.

Thank you for sticking with us. We would have loved for the Kickstarter to have succeeded, but it's not an easy thing to do. We're all about making this game the best it can be. Together, we can create something refreshing and deep.

Thanks for being part of the LITO community. Stay tuned for more updates!

With heaps of gratitude and excitement,

Black Voyage Games

notes.title: Community Update 1: Kickstarter Launch Date Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello fellow bandits,

Welcome to our first community update!

Over the past two years, we’ve been working hard on Lost in the Open, a challenging turn-based strategy game inspired by the likes of Battle Brothers, Darkest Dungeon, and many others. We plan to release the game in 2024, but before we hit that milestone, we have some exciting news to share:

Our Kickstarter campaign is going live on July 19, 2023!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/67850cf72fa4d83a23089789eda35b6e5a48ee5f.png

Lost in the Open is getting a limited-time demo to accompany the launch of its Kickstarter campaign on the 19th of July, 2023. Over the past 6 weeks, we have been working tirelessly to get the demo ready and showcase a great example of what we want to achieve with the full release of Lost in the Open. You can watch the trailer for it below.

[previewyoutube=myLKNnSjB4I;full][/previewyoutube]

Lost in the Open delivers its gameplay in a roguelike fashion, where death means starting all over again. This demo offers a full, but condensed gameplay loop, which is a shortened version of the game’s opening act. The demo includes:


 Multiple different combat scenarios
 Recruiting new bandits to join your team
 Leveling system to unlock new abilities
 Items to find from combat or buy/sell from the trader
 Flanking and positioning mechanics to reward tactical combat gameplay
 A final encounter that’s quite a challenge. Only a few of us have beaten it so far!

Your support since we launched the Steam page has been amazing. We would love your help with the launch of our Kickstarter campaign, not just through backing, but the sharing of the campaign. Our vision is to make Lost in the Open a fun, challenging, and memorable turn-based title, and a successful Kickstarter campaign will allow us to do that.

Once again, thank you for your support,



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42593482/000c53287b2bcc12a31b4d055a2ddc7fdd16caf3.png
The Black Voyage Games Team
